about: Moving heads as their light looks at night: strong where the beam is narrow and soft where it is wide; a head dimmed to a third, fainter in the same hue; one whose zoom channel widens its beam; one hung high pointing straight down, stopping at the ground in a flat pool, and one slanting down onto it, its pool stretched; one leaning toward the viewer, its end a glow; and one whose shutter is shut, dark, with no beam.
